item.title: 🔒 Westborough AI startup raises $25M to expand global operations
item.description: The financing took place on Nov. 5 through two separate transactions.

item.title: Three-story apartment building proposed for Worcester’s Millbury Street
item.description: The proposal is for a roughly 2.5-acre site at 1103 Millbury St. purchased by Asmyra for $400,000 in April.

item.title: New England taps into fossil fuels to keep grid running during storm
item.description: Even before a snowstorm enveloped the region Sunday, the New England grid was relying more heavily on dirty fuels like oil than usual.

item.title: BJ’s expanding smaller-format store concept to Florida
item.description: Occupying about 55,000 square feet, the new BJ’s Market in Delray Beach, Florida is about half the size of a typical BJ’s club.

item.title: State budget plans broad MassHealth rate freeze
item.description: Gov. Maura Healey's fiscal year 2027 budget will feature measures to tamp down on rising costs at MassHealth as the administration eyes savings for high-demand programs like personal care attendants, according to an agency official.

item.title: Researchers: MBTA housing law responsible for 7,000 new housing units so far
item.description: The report shows that only about 30% of the units in the current pipeline are located within a half-mile of train stations.

item.title: 🔒 Massport seeks to double Worcester airport passenger use by 2035, grow cargo operations
item.description: The concept of growing Worcester Regional’s cargo operations has been floated for more than 25 years.

item.title: Virtusa acquires India semiconductor company
item.description: Southborough technology firm Virtusa is expanding its presence further into Asia with the acquisition of SmartSoC Solutions, a semiconductor manufacturer out of India.

item.title: Worcester affordable housing redevelopment bonded $38M from MassDevelopment
